title: Constant Functions Have Zero Stable Influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $c\in\mathbb R$. The constant function with value $c$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube has stable influence at most $0$ at every coordinate when the noise parameter is $1$ (equivalently, when the parameters $\varepsilon$ and $\delta$ are both $0$).
hypotheses_covered: The function is constant with value $c$
The bound holds at every coordinate
